ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 2155 of 2021 (uncodified amendments creating the Beneficial Owner Registry, Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales, administered by DIAN); Decree 830 of 2021 (implementing regulation); Law 526 of 1999 (creating UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT criminal code provisions); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia Basic Legal Circular, Title IV, AML/CFT chapters; DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2022 (RUB technical and filing requirements).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in UBO's jurisdiction of nationality or residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all direct and indirect shareholders, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and Colombian domestic PEP databases maintained by UIAF and Fiscalia General de la Nacion. Additionally, the screening must include negative news checks, law enforcement lists, and local Colombian registry disqualifications. Enhanced due diligence is required for any match or PEP-related relationship; the full AML/CFT file must be retained for at least ten years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) via Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá; official portal: www.rues.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Spanish; foreign-language names are permitted only in Latin-alphabet transliteration complying with Spanish lexicographical usage and standard S.A.S. rules requiring the abbreviation 'S.A.S.' after the approved name. The name must contain at least one distinguishing word or syllable; homonymic or phonetically identical names are prohibited.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Corporate names suggesting activity requiring a financial, insurance, or public utility concession or ministerial approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration appeal (recurso de reposición) directly with the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá within ten business days of the notice of rejection. If denied, the applicant may file a second appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within five business days of the reconsideration decision. A new name reservation may be submitted in parallel after first rejection, without prejudice to the pending appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for low-risk developer infrastructure and DevOps cloud tooling, provided the office has a physical commercial address in Colombia, actual personnel or contracted administrative services at that address, a local mailbox for official tax and judicial notifications, and availability for the mandatory personal inspection of books by DIAN or the Cámara de Comercio. Pure virtual offices with no physical reception and no local staff are not advisable for infrastructure companies because of commercial substance expectations under Colombia's transfer pricing and low-risk residency rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15-20% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by DIAN or the Cámara de Comercio within the first twelve months of operation; the likelihood rises if the registered office is a co-working or virtual-service address and the company's invoicing volume exceeds USD 1,000,000 annually.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1-6, 17-21, 25-29; Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 98-126, 353-375; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Libro 2, Parte 2, Título 1.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio con jurisdicción en el domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal (www.rues.org.co).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (private incorporation instrument and bylaws), authenticated before a notary only when aportes en especie (in-kind contributions) of real property are involved; registered in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for a S.A.S. (Law 1258/2008, Art. 6). The subscribed capital may be paid in cash or in kind within installments not exceeding two years from incorporation. No escrow account is mandated; the payment schedule must be recorded in the bylaws and certified by the legal representative.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE INCORPORATING SHAREHOLDERS OF [●] S.A.S. WHEREAS the company is incorporated under Law 1258 of 2008; RESOLVED: 1. To approve the private incorporation instrument and Bylaws in full. 2. To adopt the registered office at [●], Municipality of [●], Colombia. 3. To ratify the subscription and payment schedule of [●] ordinary shares representing the subscribed capital of COP [●]. 4. To appoint [●] as General Legal Representative and [●] as alternate, with the powers stated in the Bylaws. 5. To appoint [●] as Statutory Auditor if the legal thresholds so require. 6. To authorize opening the corporate bank account and executing pre-incorporation acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Homonimia Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with municipal jurisdiction via the RUES virtual office (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES platform, file the electronic name consultation form, and submit up to three alternative corporate names in order of preference. The system issues the Certificado de Homonimia confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered. The certificate remains valid for 30 calendar days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to homonimia or similarity, immediately resubmit the next available candidate from the list; if the objection is contested, file a written opposition with the Cámara de Comercio within 5 business days supported by trademark or registration evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – virtual RUT module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Pre-RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application on the DIAN transactional portal specifying the intended legal nature S.A.S., the ISIC code 6201 principal activity, the responsible SAT parameter, and the company address. The Pre-RUT generates a provisional NIT and must be presented at the Chamber registration step.
required_dossiers: Identity document of the legal representative
Proof of domicile or intended registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Pre-RUT is rejected for address or activity inconsistencies, correct the validation flags in the DIAN portal and re-submit within 10 business days; escalation to the DIAN assistance desk in person is available at the competent territorial office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Authentication and Execution of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary 1 of the municipality of domicile (optional authentication) and the incorporating shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución, including the bylaws: corporate name, address, corporate purpose (IT and DevOps infrastructure services), capital and share classes, payment schedule, administration body, and legal representative powers. Execute the instrument by all shareholders; if tangible real property is contributed, elevate the instrument to public deed before a notary.
required_dossiers: Copy of each shareholder's identification document
Chamber of Commerce standard incorporation forms (certificado y formulario de registro)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes formal defects, amend the instrument and re-notarize within 5 business days; if shareholders cannot appear physically, execute via authenticating email with digital certificates approved by the Cámara de Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Payment of Registration Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with municipal jurisdiction / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the executed incorporation instrument, completed registration forms and Pre-RUT at the Cámara de Comercio window or via the RUES digital workflow. Pay the commercial registration fee (derechos de inscripción: fixed form and processing rights plus a proportional rate of approximately 0.7% of subscribed capital), the registry tax (impuesto de registro, 0.7% of subscribed capital, reduced to 0% for small-company thresholds where applicable), and the Chamber certification fee. The Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a formal query (requerimiento), the legal representative or shareholders must cure the observations within 10 business days by filing corrected documents; if the name is conflicted, substitute name or withdraw and restart; if the registration is rejected, appeal via the recurso de reposición before the Chamber within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT, Electronic Invoicing Authorization and Tax Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Chamber registration, finalize the RUT in the DIAN system using the new definitive NIT and the certified registered address; verify the assigned tax obligations (income tax, ICA national treatment, VAT for platform sales if applicable, and withholdings); apply for the electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) certificate — the 'habilitación' of the software provider and numbering authorization for the initial range of invoices.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Chamber
Bylaws and NIT tax classification details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the tax obligations at registration (e.g., incorrect tariff classification), adjust the activity code and economic activity digits in the RUT before the 10 business-day deadline; if e-invoicing authorization is suspended, verify the responsible software provider prerequisites and re-apply through the DIAN transactional services.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Registration, Bank Account and Operational Compliance Kickoff
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal treasury (Secretaría de Hacienda), Cámara de Comercio, commercial bank of choice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the local enrollment for the Industria y Comercio (ICA) tax declaration and complement the unified municipality form when required; open the corporate USD and COP bank account (target rails: Mercury-ACH and Stripe Billing) submitting the certification of existence and appointed officers; notify the relevant officials of the registered office and secure the municipal land-use certificate compatibility for office use.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease contract or lease letter for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality queries the ICA enrollment, correct tax classification codes and resubmit; if the bank rejects KYC, provide additional due diligence on the ultimate beneficial owner and resubmit within 15 business days; if the land-use certificate is inconsistent with the address, procure a zoning letter from the planning authority (Curaduría Urbana).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority applies; sector oversight rests with the Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies (MinTIC) and the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for digital services, neither of which grants a production/manufacturing permit for cloud and DevOps tooling under ISIC 6201.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — pure software and cloud infrastructure services. VUE/electronic invoicing authorization from DIAN and the commercial registration certificate are the only operating permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — non-industrial, non-manufacturing digital services; no physical plant, no combustion, and no effluent production; no EIA, environmental registration, or discharge permit is required under Decreto 1076 de 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable: no wastewater or VOC discharges generated. Office waste handling must follow municipal solid waste ordinances; end-of-life IT and electronic equipment must be managed under Decreto 284 de 2018 (waste electrical and electronic equipment) and delivered to authorized collectors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office occupancy in Colombia requires a fire safety certificate (Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad Humana contra Incendios) from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos for the rented office; the Certificado de Uso de Suelo from the municipal planning office or Curaduría Urbana validates zoning compliance; the employer must affiliate the company with an Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) and implement the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) prior to hiring staff. No structural load inspection or industrial plant clearance is required for a software office environment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – portal: https://www.dian.gov.co (transactional portal: https://muisca.dian.gov.co)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign person or entity obtaining Colombian-source activities must procure a Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) and an Registro Único Tributario (RUT) before commencing business. The procedure requires appointing a Colombian legal representative or attorney-in-fact, completing the pre-registration via DIAN's Muisca portal using the assigned institutional credential, submitting the RUT form (Formulario de Registro Único Tributario) with the constitutional documents (charter and bylaws of the SAS), proof of foreign entity existence and apostilled certification, and powers of attorney. DIAN issues the NIT immediately in most cases; the RUT is the single certificate of tax registration and contains the NIT, address, activity code (ISIC 6201), and applicable tax obligations. Non-resident owners do not require local minimum capital, but the local legal representative must maintain valid identification and a local tax domicile for service of process.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (a Colombian S.A.S. is treated as a separate juridical and tax resident entity subject to Colombian corporate income tax on worldwide income; there is no automatic pass-through classification and no check-the-box mechanism under Colombian national law); 'Territorial_Scope' applies only to certain Colombian offshore service regimes under free-trade-zone rules, which are not default.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for pass-through classification. Available statutory elections include: (i) elective inclusion in the Régimen Simple de Tributación for qualifying small-activity taxpayers under Law 2010 of 2019, replacing regular corporate income tax and IVA duties with a single consolidated payment on gross income, subject to turnover thresholds and activity restrictions; (ii) voluntary application for Zone Franca status (autorización de usuario de zona franca) conferring preferential territorial 20% CIT treatment on export-related income, subject to DIAN approval, minimum investment and employment commitments, and permanent establishment conditions; (iii) for VAT purposes, an election to be treated as a non-responsable or exempt operator only if the entity's sole transactions are excluded or non-taxed, otherwise registration is mandatory. No hybrid mismatch election is available because Colombian tax law does not apply entity classification check-the-box rules; foreign hybrid instruments remain governed by the mismatch-restriction articles of Colombian tax law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.No additional 'hybrid mismatch' election: This key is a placeholder to satisfy strict JSON schema; it should be ignored.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido), a credit-method VAT also referred to as Impuesto a las Ventas
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 (no economic threshold): any legal entity, irrespective of turnover, carrying out taxable sales of goods or services within Colombian territory is required to register in the RUT as a 'responsable' and to charge IVA. Solely exempt or non-taxable operators may remain unregistered but must still obtain an RUT and NIT for identity and payroll compliance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FEV) applies to all taxable persons, including SAS entities, from 2023 onwards. Invoices must be generated as XML validated in near-real-time through DIAN's web services; the issuance process requires digital signature (certificado digital), assignment of a single digital stamp or equivalent (CUFE/CUDE), transmission of the invoice before the applicable deadline (generally within 1 day), and receipt of DIAN validation/acceptance. Every export invoice must also be transmitted with complemento of goods or services export, and the export transaction must be backed by the electronic export declaration. The failure to obtain DIAN validation renders the invoice legally non-compliant and disallows input IVA credits where applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods and exports of services (including software development, database management, API monitoring, PaaS/SaaS cloud tools) are zero-rated (0% VAT) when the services are utilised exclusively outside of Colombia, the recipient is not resident in Colombia, the service is not connected to tangible goods or real property located in Colombia, and the exporter qualifies as a 'usuario acogido' to export treatment. The service must be performed from Colombia in the sense that the developer tools export contract, the technical specification, and the billing arrangements support offshore beneficial use. Compliance requires a written export services contract, electronic export service documentation (for foreign exchange purposes), and compliance with DIAN's export service registration procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic customs export declaration (Declaración de Exportación Electrónica) validated by DIAN through the VUCE / Exporta Facíl system, including the SAS exporter's NIT and ISIC 6201 activity code
Commercial invoice and packing list (transmitted as the electronic FEV export invoice with CUFE and export complement)
Bill of Lading (for goods mode) or air waybill / courier airway bill and master waybill where applicable
Supporting export contract and technical specification proving the offshore beneficiary, the delivery mode (SaaS/cloud), and absence of Colombian in-country consumption

Certificate of foreign exchange repatriation (Certificado de reintegro de divisas) issued by the local bank or authorized payment processor, evidencing receipt of the export proceeds from the non-resident buyer

Inward remittance certificate / SWIFT MT103 evidence if payment is received by a Colombian bank or a foreign account disclosed to DIAN under the foreign-exchange regimen (when using Stripe Billing or Mercury ACH rails)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are scrutinized under Articles 485 and 487 of the Colombian Tax Statute. If the exporter fails to prove the export nature of the transaction or the foreign exchange repatriation deadline is missed, DIAN may retroactively reclassify the sale as a domestic transaction subject to 19% VAT, eliminate input VAT credits, and assess the unpaid IVA together with default interest (current rate of approximately 1.5% per month or fiscal equivalent). The inaccuracy penalty under Article 647 can amount up to 200% of the difference between the tax declared and the correct tax liability, and knowingly fraudulent export invoices attract criminal penalties under the Colombian criminal tax offence regime (delitos contra el orden tributario), including imprisonment, fines, and loss of tax registration. The exporter also risks cancellation of periodic VAT returns and refunds, and, in respect of false export documentation, adverse reference in DIAN's risk-scoring system for a period of up to ten years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia; the operative FX regime is established by Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Resolution 8 of 2000 of the Junta Directiva, and the comprehensive Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of 2018. All cross-border treasury flows must be channeled through authorized exchange-market intermediaries (IMCs), which are Colombian commercial banks and financial corporations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is convertible under a managed-floating regime with a daily TRM fixing. Current-account operations (software export proceeds, royalties, profit remittances) are liberalized but remain subject to mandatory channeling, exchange declarations, and documentary compliance. Capital-account inflows (FDI) are freely accepted but require registration with the Banco de la República as a precondition for future dividend remittance and capital repatriation. Practical hurdles include the six-month repatriation window for export receipts, the obligation to prove the CIT-paid status of distributable earnings before remitting dividends offshore, and IMC operational control over declaration forms.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory channeling ratio is 100%: all proceeds of ISIC 6201/NAICS 511210 software-service exports must be canalized through an IMC within six (6) months from the invoice/collection-note date, either by conversion into COP at the TRM or by credit to a Banco de la República-registered foreign-currency or compensation account. Conversion into COP is elective; however, neither holding funds abroad without prior registration nor late channeling is permitted. Extension requests must be filed before expiry of the statutory window, and breach triggers fines by the DIAN and the Banco de la República.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: COP operational current account plus USD foreign-currency account (IMC channeling and trade desk)
COP operational current account plus USD foreign-currency account (corporate treasury and export settlement)
COP operational current account plus multi-currency export-proceeds account
COP current account plus USD/EUR remittance rails via the BBVA global network
COP operational account plus USD account optimized for North American correspondent corridors

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury locus; Medium as an ancillary collection layer. Offshore digital EMIs (Mercury, Wise, Payoneer, Stripe Treasury) are not authorized IMCs and cannot legally substitute the channeling obligation. Receipts parked in such accounts must be repatriated to an IMC within the statutory window and reported in exchange declarations. A Colombian SAS may lawfully hold a foreign-currency account abroad (cuenta de compensación) only after prior registration with the Banco de la República; an unauthorized offshore account triggers administrative sanctions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required: either the foreign or local legal representative attends the branch, or a locally appointed attorney-in-fact (apoderado) signs on the company's behalf under an apostilled, notarized special power of attorney. Fully remote onboarding is accepted only in low-risk profiles where the bank's SFC-validated digital KYC protocol with biometric video verification applies. Foreign directors should plan for one in-person execution of the account agreement and the client-risk interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident 100% shareholding with perceived opacity in the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registro de Beneficiario Final (RBF-UGPP) certificate; apostilled certificate of incorporation and share register; corporate organization chart evidencing operational substance; shareholder bank references; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-ticket inbound micro-payments from numerous foreign clients inconsistent with the declared software business (NAICS 511210 / ISIC 6201).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export service contracts and SLAs; sample client invoices; Stripe and Mercury settlement statements; completed bank transactional-profile (perfil transaccional) questionnaire; public product and website evidence of the DevOps-cloud activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party settlement in which the remitting payer differs from the contractual client (PSP aggregation or marketplace payer structures).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements with Stripe and Mercury; platform settlement reconciliation reports; collection ledger; written PSP-aggregation model explanation; client-side assignment or set-off agreements; pre-emptive submission to the bank's AML unit for approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid circular flow: a foreign capital injection followed immediately by high-value outbound disbursements to overseas technology suppliers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions on capitalization and operating budget; investor wiring instructions; wire confirmation receipts; cloud-infrastructure supplier contracts; pro-forma cash-flow forecast; monthly tax filings showing live operational substance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder wires USD via the IMC trade desk (convertible at TRM into COP or credited to the SAS USD account) referencing 'INVERSION INTERNACIONAL DIRECTA - APORTE CAPITAL SAS', the company NIT, and the applicable FDI purpose code. The IMC issues the Exchange Declaration (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional), and the FDI registration (Registro de Inversión Internacional) must be perfected within six (6) months of the contribution date. The funds cannot be applied to resident obligations before registration is validated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border payments for software subscriptions, cloud infrastructure, and professional fees clear via SWIFT MT103 through the IMC's correspondent network; commercial letters of credit are reserved for high-value infrastructure procurement. Local COP liquidity is settled through ACH Colombia (low-value clearing) and the SEN (Banco de la República high-value settlement). Every outbound FX disbursement requires the applicable exchange declaration, the corresponding tax withholding certificates, and IMC channeling evidence to complete the audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable forwards executed with authorized IMCs (TRM reference and underlying exposure required)
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) traded with licensed counterparties for offshore hedge positions
USD/COP cross-currency swaps covering medium-term payment obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registration Renewal (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered municipal jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March of each calendar year for all existing commercial registrants
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 10% surcharge and interest accrue immediately after 31 March; continuous non-renewal leads to temporary administrative suspension and eventual strike-off (cancelación de la matrícula) from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiary Report (Información de Beneficiarios Finales / UBO Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within the annual corporate income tax filing period assigned by tax ID last digit, typically between January and June of the fiscal year following the reporting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely or incorrect filing subjects the S.A.S. to graduated DIAN fines of up to COP 50 million; persistent non-compliance may prevent issuance of fiscal certificates and trigger administrative enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and Filing of Annual Financial Statements (Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio and, where applicable, Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve financial statements within three months of fiscal year-end; the approved statements must be filed with the Chamber of Commerce by 31 March in line with the renewal deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file blocks renewal and certification of good standing; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines up to COP 50 million and order recalculation of statutory books.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal if total assets or gross annual income exceed 5,000 monthly minimum wages (SMLMV, approx. USD 1.7 million) or if the company has more than 200 employees; a smaller S.A.S. may voluntarily appoint an independent auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS/NIIF as adopted in Colombia: NIIF Plenas for entities entering the Group 1 regime and NIIF para Pymes for eligible small and medium enterprises.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file an annual UBO declaration with DIAN identifying all individuals with direct or indirect shareholding and control, even if unchanged. Any share transfer must first be recorded in the shareholder ledger; the updated beneficial ownership structure must be reflected in the next annual UBO filing. Inaccuracies carry fines and jeopardize corporate administrative standing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – 1,200 per year for registered office and corporate agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 – 3,500 per year for certified independent audit services when mandatory
